method_fact: a lock run against a moving repository measures the motion, AND a long run moves the repository itself (class E): the slow lane must be run quiescent and its diff inspected, never committed blind -- 2 of 9 reported findings (22%) were drift artifacts, and 2 real defects appeared only in the tree rather than in the report

side_effects_class_E.defect: run_pool opened the grid with 'a' and the arc has no resume logic, so every re-run appended another 216 cells; this bench held 648 rows = 3 x 216
side_effects_class_E.consequence: aggregate re-derived M_grid_cells 216 -> 432 and halved the Sidak alpha (2.374e-4 -> 1.187e-4) off multiplicity that was never tested
side_effects_class_E.why_no_lock_caught_it: the error was in the conservative direction and the grid is gitignored
side_effects_class_E.fix: writer truncates; aggregator de-duplicates by (name, D, H); grid restored to 216 unique rows; banked final_report.json reproduced EXACTLY

side_effects_class_E.defect: the verifier recorded CCB_PATH raw, so its first successful re-run replaced the banked hand-sanitized '<repo>/...' placeholders with this bench's absolute paths
